summary:
Package C (deck details) is done and verified by a full build. The coachroof and the sprayhood are now built as height fields over a plan outline: the height above the base is a profile of the inward distance from the outline (a sloped side that rounds into the roof with radius R), lofted through x-sections. This gives a sloped, rounded coachroof front and rounded roof edges without OCC fillets, which fail on these surfaces.

- **Coachroof front:** the 45 deg front that the old cut never produced now exists. On the centreline it rises from the deck at 2200 (1217) to 1340 at 2330, matching the drawing, then rounds into the roof (1351 at 2360). It stays rounded in plan.
- **Roof edge and sides:** roof-edge radius R40 along the sides and R60 over the front. The sides lean in 12 deg from the unchanged deck-plan outline (SIDEDECK 210).
- **Sprayhood:** redrawn from the dashed profile. It runs 4945-5990 (top 5155-5975, about 170 mm shorter aft), with a ~61 deg raked front rounded in plan, R110 front/top edge, R150 shoulders and an R90 aft top edge. It stays solid as before, and aft of the coachroof its sides run straight down to the side deck outboard of the coaming.
- **Winches:** moved from 5900 to 6540, where both 1:50 drawings show them (plan circle at about 6555, profile 6450-6590). They sit mid-coaming, well aft of the hood, as domed drums of 110/84 mm diameter, 90 mm high.
- **Cleats:** horn cleats of 180 x 45 x 60 mm, rounded all round with no fillet.
- **Anchor roller:** replaced by a low stemhead fitting (300 x 90, 55 mm above the deck, R27 top). It stays on the deck, 15 mm deep and inside the deck outline.
- **Coaming:** the top line is a smooth quadratic fit within 4.8 mm of the table, with a soft max against the deck+40 floor and a smoothstep down into the deck from 6750 to 6900. Both top edges have an R25 fillet; this works because the coaming is built as a free-standing ring around the well.
- **Hatches:** R20 top fillet instead of the 15 mm chamfer.

Three problems turned up along the way and were fixed:
- **Sliver tessellation:** spline points spaced by curvature with uniform parameters gave 0.5% volume error and 940k sliver triangles on the coachroof. Arc-length sampling gives 0.04% error and about 15x fewer triangles.
- **Coachroof station spacing:** one spacing (90/45 mm) made the slide-hatch union silently lose volume. build.py's robust_union caught it, and the chosen 100 mm spacing is verified.
- **Hood aft corner:** the end of the plan outline produced a fold and non-manifold edges there. The corners are now rounded by scaling the last sections instead.

Interfaces are unchanged: roof_z(3400) is identical, so the mast hole and the mast length in rig.py stay the same, and the stanchion and pulpit hole code and the cockpit, companionway and window cuts work. No other module changed. The patch applies cleanly on top of lines.patch and stern.patch, and the deck union chain passes on the combined A+B+C code.

changes.what: Added a height-field builder (_Planform signed distance and outline normal, _edge_profile sloped side plus radius into the roof, arc-length _resample, _hf_section/_hf_wire/_hf_solid loft). coachroof() is now built with it: front 45 deg, sides 78 deg, R60/R40 roof edge, base on the deck-plan outline. Removed the useless _step_wedge cut. roof_z is smoothed with local parabolic blends (_knee_table) that leave x=3400 untouched; added roof_surface_z. New sprayhood() on the same builder: raked front rounded in plan, round shoulders, rounded aft edge, legs down to the side deck. coaming_top_z: quadratic fit plus smooth max plus smoothstep down into the deck. coaming_block: a ring (slab minus the well grown by 2 mm) with R25 fillets on both top edges. Hatches get an R20 top fillet via _try_fillet, which keeps the part unchanged if a fillet fails or comes out invalid. Soft-min (_smin) for the cockpit and coaming widths. Removed unused _interp/_plan_prism/_outline.

winches(): domed drum on a rounded base, centred on the coaming at WINCH_X and sized to fit it. _cleat(): horn cleat lofted through a closed spline side profile scaled down toward the sides, so every edge is rounded without a fillet. stemhead() replaces anchor_roller: a low slot-shaped block with R27 top, only 15 mm into the deck and inside the deck outline. additions() updated.

Placed next to the related parameters: COACH_TOP_BLEND, COACH_FRONT_ANGLE/SIDE_ANGLE/EDGE_R/FRONT_EDGE_R; HATCH_RAD, HATCH_EDGE_R; COAMING_DOWN_X, COAMING_FWD, COAMING_RAD, COAMING_EDGE_R, COAMING_GAP, WIDTH_BLEND; WINCH_X 5900->6540 (from the drawings), WINCH_BASE_D/DRUM_D/H (replaces WINCH_INSET), CLEAT_INSET, CLEAT_L/W/H, STEMHEAD_X/W/H; SPRAY_X0 4945, SPRAY_TOP_X0 5155, SPRAY_X1 5990, plus TOP_FALL, CAMBER, SIDE_ANGLE, EDGE_R, FRONT_R, AFT_R, FRONT_L, INSET (replaces SPRAY_OVERHANG). The COAMING_TOP_Z table lines are unchanged.

measurements:
Final build (build4, final code), build_check.py, abs 0.01 mm / 0.05 rad:
- 1 solid, isValid=True, plastic 228 cm3 (baseline 228.6).
- bbox x 4.0..7984.7 and beam 2680.6 mm, both unchanged; top 1743.5 mm (was 1745).
- A1 diagonal fit: True, 205.9 x 205.9 x 104.8 mm.
- Build time 296 s on a loaded machine.

meshcheck:
- build4: 115 non-manifold edges. Baseline fine STL: 124.
- Every remaining cluster also exists in the baseline (stem/forefoot, keel, one inside the hull at x 626-675). My deck parts add 0, and the baseline cluster at the old hood/coachroof junction is gone.
- Earlier builds had 231 (cleats with two fillet passes) and 25 (hood aft corner); both were fixed.

Interfaces (build3 BREP; same code path in build4):
- Mast hole 134.9 x 105.0 mm centred at (3400.1, 0.0). Design is 135 x 105 at x=3400; roof_z(3400) = 1378.33, unchanged.
- Pulpit hole x=520 at (520.3, 241.2), diameter 36.0.

Chin ahead of the stem below the deck: baseline 812 vertices, up to 107 mm ahead; V10 0 vertices (beyond the 7 mm slack of my stem line).

Heights:
- Bow fitting top 1265 (old block 1353), so 55 mm above the deck.
- Stern cleat top 1070 (was 1110).
- Winch at 6540: top 1210, 90 mm over the coaming.

Coachroof centreline:
- z = 1216.9 (deck) at 2200, 1275 at 2260, 1340.5 at 2330, 1350.9 at 2360. Drawing: deck at 2200 to roof at 2330.
- Section at x=3400: base on the outline at W=966, roof edge at about y=930.

Loft and fillet checks:
- Coachroof loft volume 2.3913 m3 against 2.3910 m3 from integrating the exact sections.
- Fillets confirmed applied: coaming R25 on both edges (dV -0.94 L), hatches R20, winch and stemhead tops.
- Coaming top fit max residual 4.8 mm.

STL size:
- 79 MB at 0.01 mm / 0.05 rad; baseline 42 MB at the same settings.
- The rounded fittings drive it: one cleat is 116k triangles at that setting but 22k at 0.02 mm / 0.1 rad.
- build1 at 0.02 mm / 0.1 rad was 22.9 MB.
open_issues: README.md will be out of date (not in patch scope): line 83-84 gives the sprayhood as 5 135-6 150 (now 4 945-5 990); line 475 'Ruffens front er en rett 45-flate. Paa originalen er den avrundet.' no longer holds; the 'Videre arbeid' note on non-manifold edges should be rechecked with the final export settings.

The coachroof and hood are lofted over C.deck_half_breadth/sheer_z/deck_z, so package A's new curves change their sections. My union chain passed on the combined lines+stern+deck code (bare hull, no keel/strake/hollowing), but the integrated full build must be checked. If OCC misbehaves, robust_union now fails loudly; I saw one station layout make the slide-hatch union lose volume.

STL size: the rounded fittings and lofted deck surfaces about double the triangle count at very fine settings (79 MB at 0.01 mm / 0.05 rad against 42 MB baseline). With 0.02 mm / 0.1 rad the file was 23 MB; package D's export settings decide.

The sprayhood is still solid (an unchanged design decision), with a flat aft face. Aft of the coachroof its legs come down to the side deck outboard of the coaming, which is plausible from IMG_9304 but not confirmed. A shallow recess in the aft face to suggest the open hoop was not done.

WINCH_X moved from 5900 to 6540 based on the plan circle (x~6555, y~930) and the profile silhouette (6450-6590). The winch is part of the hull print, so no other part depends on it, but it is a visible relocation.

The coaming ring stands 2 mm outboard of the well wall (COAMING_GAP) to avoid coincident faces with the cockpit cut. This leaves a 2 mm full-scale (0.07 mm model) ledge at deck level inside the well, invisible in print.
Cleat dimensions (180 x 45 x 60) and the stemhead size are estimates; the drawings give no sizes. The 12 deg coachroof side lean comes from the photos and the Bambu reference, not a measurement.
